Headquarters: Australia
 
URL: https://zandahealth.com/eu/

Product Owner

Remote | Permanent Contractor | Core EU Collaboration Hours
Reports to: Product Manager

Are you a product driven problem solver who enjoys turning customer insight into things that actually get built? Do you love turning complexity into clarity, aligning teams, and shaping product experiences that genuinely make people’s lives easier? If so, we’d love to meet you!

We build software that takes the stress, chaos, and friction out of managing a health practice. As our newest Product Owner, you’ll play a pivotal role in translating vision into action, turning customer needs into features and driving product outcomes that truly matter.

You’re someone on the rise - intelligent, opinionated (in the best way), and ready to make an impact. You’re not easily swayed, and you’re happy to take a stand when it serves the customer and the product. You connect dots, ask great questions, and care deeply about delivering value. If that sounds like you… read on!

You’re Excited To

• 

Be the voice of the customer; advocate for user needs and pain points.

• 

Maintain deep customer understanding and share insights with key teams.

• 

Translate product priorities into clear, prioritised & actionable items for your team

• 

Work closely with engineering to understand constraints, dependencies, and system behaviour

• 

Build alignment, trust and collaborate seamlessly across Product, Engineering, and Customer Support

• 

Ensure continuous delivery of value; own the lifecycle from discovery to post-launch iteration.

• 

Guide product decisions that make a real difference for the people using Zanda every day

• 

Communicate clearly across async and real-time channels.

• 

Surface risks early and drive grounded, data-informed decisions.

• 

Contribute to risk-based analysis of product changes and support identification of potential vulnerabilities

What You Bring to the Team

Experience 

• 

2+ years of hands-on product ownership experience (SaaS experience an asset)

• 

Proven ability to translate customer pains into clear requirements and impactful improvements

• 

Strong understanding of agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and product development architecture

• 

Experience in another role before moving into product - a Customer Success, Support, or similar background is a real plus

• 

Demonstrated experience working with remote, cross-cultural teams across multiple time zones

Skills 

• 

Customer Insight & Discovery - understands user needs, pain points, and motivations.

• 

Strategic Thinking -  connects decisions in your product area to customer needs and team priorities

• 

Data-Informed Decision Making - uses data to guide choices, even with ambiguity.

• 

Clear & Adaptive Communication - complex to simple, and with the audience in mind. 

• 

Cross-Functional Collaboration -  works effectively across teams and builds influence through trust, not title.

• 

Prioritisation - confidently prioritises what drives the most impact and eliminates noise.

• 

Technical Fluency - understands enough to engage meaningfully with engineering.

• 

Risk Identification & Mitigation - surfaces risks early and makes grounded decisions.

• 

Problem Solving & Critical Thinking - breaks down complexity into clear, actionable steps.

Traits 

• 

High Ownership Mindset - proactive and treats the product like a business.

• 

Collaborative & Empathetic - builds trust quickly and embraces diverse perspectives.

• 

Calm Under Pressure - steady when navigating competing priorities or ambiguity.

• 

Adaptable & Curious - thrives in fast-changing environments, shows interest in emerging technologies - particularly AI and automation.

• 

Integrity-Driven - transparent, reliable, and grounded in facts, not ego.

• 

Opinionated (in the right ways) – advocates confidently for what's right for the customer, and isn't easily swayed.

• 

Energetic & Self-Starter - brings momentum, enthusiasm, and a bias for action.

• 

Strategic Yet Practical - able to zoom out and zoom in fluidly.

• 

Growth Oriented - desire to grow, stretch, take on more responsibility, and help influence direction.

• 

Customer-Obsessed - curious, empathetic, and motivated to solve real user problems.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

✅ Work from Anywhere
We’ve been a fully distributed team from the start - no offices, no commute, just great people from all over the world doing meaningful work together.
✅ Flexibility & Autonomy
We care about outcomes, not clock-watching. Outside of agreed core hours that align to your role, your time is yours - whether that’s doing the school run or squeezing in a midday gym class.
✅ Generous Paid Time Off
Balance matters. We offer paid time off and expect you to take it - because rest fuels great work.
✅ High Trust, Results Driven
We strip away red tape so you can focus on impact. No pointless meetings or rigid hierarchies -  just space to move fast, solve problems, and make a difference.
✅ Growth & Innovation
You’ll be encouraged to experiment, stretch your skills, and bring YOUR bold ideas to the table. Everyone at Zanda contributes to shaping what’s next.
✅ Inspiring Teammates
You’ll work alongside passionate, curious people who support and cheer each other on - even across time zones. Collaboration is how we win.
✅ Meaningful Impact
Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Your work will directly improve lives.
✅ Competitive Pay
We hire the best people - wherever they are - and we make sure they feel valued and well-rewarded for the work they do.

About Zanda

Zanda is a fast-growing, globally loved practice management platform that helps health professionals run smooth, efficient practices - and spend more time caring for their patients. We’re used by thousands of clinics across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, the US, and Canada, and we’re just getting started.

Our mission is simple: make health practice management easy and enjoyable.
To do that, we need brilliant, passionate people who are excited by innovation, love solving complex problems, and thrive in fast-moving environments.

At Zanda, you’ll join a globally distributed team that’s small enough to move fast and think big - and driven enough to deliver work that makes a real impact. We live our values every day:

• 

Growth: We stretch ourselves, learn constantly, and support each other’s development.

• 

Reliability: We follow through on our commitments and show up for our team and customers.

• 

Impact: Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients.

• 

Teamwork: We win together -  celebrating wins, sharing ideas, and having each other’s backs.

  Zanda collects and processes your personal data for the purposes of managing employment candidate application and recruitment-related activities as well as for organisational planning purposes, for further detail, please refer to the Zanda Health Privacy Policy.

This is an exciting time to join Zanda. We’re self-funded, scaling quickly, and building something that truly changes lives. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a meaningful difference -  we’d love to hear from you.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zanda-health-product-owner

ecb89ca6644663f3.description:
The Revenue team is a highly visible, global team responsible for accurate and timely revenue reporting. The team manages the monthly and quarterly revenue close, supports contract review and accounting conclusions, evaluates revenue treatment for new and existing product offerings, maintains controls over revenue reporting, and supports revenue forecasting and analytics.

This role will lead the Revenue Operations team in Gurugram, India, with responsibility for managing and developing Revenue Managers and Revenue Analysts. The Senior Manager will be the primary point of leadership for the India Revenue Operations team and will be accountable for the quality and timely execution of the revenue processes owned by the team.

The role will partner closely with global Revenue leadership and cross-functional teams to manage close execution, resolve complex revenue and operational issues, strengthen processes and controls, and continue building the capabilities of the India team.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA, CA, or equivalent qualification preferred
  • 10+ years of relevant experience, including experience in revenue accounting or revenue operations at a public, high-growth SaaS or technology company
  • Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing Managers and individual contributors
  • Strong working knowledge of ASC 606, including experience with SaaS, cloud, and usage-based revenue models
  • Experience owning complex revenue close processes, including revenue recognition, journal entries, account reconciliations, revenue allocations, and related analytics
  • Experience reviewing customer contracts and evaluating non-standard terms and revenue accounting considerations
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting controls, SOX requirements, and external audit support
  • Demonstrated ability to independently assess complex issues, determine appropriate next steps and escalation, and drive matters through resolution
  • Experience improving or scaling accounting processes through standardization, automation, documentation, or enhanced controls
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work with large data sets and identify trends, exceptions, and underlying drivers
  • Experience with ERP and CRM systems; NetSuite and Salesforce experience preferred
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions, levels, and global time zones
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and sound judgment

Position Expectations

  • Lead, manage, and develop the Revenue Operations team in Gurugram, including Revenue Managers and Revenue Analysts, with accountability for team performance, development, workload allocation, and effective delegation
  • Own the monthly and quarterly revenue close activities within the India team's scope, including revenue analyses, journal entries, account reconciliations, revenue recognition, and related review activities, ensuring accurate and timely completion
  • Establish clear ownership, review, and escalation expectations across the team and ensure issues are identified and addressed on a timely basis
  • Review complex sales transactions within the Company's ERP and revenue systems to ensure the accuracy of underlying data, revenue allocations, and revenue schedules
  • Review contract analyses and provide guidance on revenue treatment for complex or non-standard arrangements under ASC 606 and the Company's accounting policies
  • Apply judgment to revenue accounting and operational issues, determine when escalation is required, and drive issues to resolution in partnership with global Revenue leadership and other stakeholders
  • Lead quarterly review and year-end audit activities for the revenue processes owned by the India team, including coordination of supporting documentation and resolution of auditor questions
  • Review revenue analytics and complex data sets to identify trends, anomalies, and potential financial reporting or operational risks and communicate findings to Revenue leadership
  • Partner with OTC, Legal, FP&A, Product, Cloud Engineering, FinTech, and other cross-functional teams on initiatives and issues with revenue accounting or operational implications
  • Partner with global Revenue leadership to align processes, controls, and operating practices across the broader Revenue organization
  • Identify and lead opportunities to improve the efficiency, scalability, and control environment of Revenue Operations through process improvement, automation, standardization, and documentation
  • Coach Revenue Managers and Analysts to strengthen technical knowledge, operational ownership, judgment, and issue escalation
  • Support new products, systems, and business initiatives by assessing revenue accounting and operational impacts and helping ensure appropriate processes and controls are established
  • Lead revenue-related projects and other initiatives requiring coordination across the India Revenue team and global business partners

Success Measures

First 30 Days

  • A successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of the Company's business, product offerings, revenue streams, key systems, close processes, controls, and team responsibilities, while establishing relationships with the Gurugram team and key global stakeholders

3 to 6 Months

  • The Senior Manager will be independently overseeing the revenue close activities within the India team's scope, with clear ownership and escalation expectations established across Revenue Managers and Analysts. The individual will also have identified key opportunities to improve processes, controls, documentation, and team capability

6 to 9 Months

  • The Senior Manager will be operating as a trusted partner to Revenue leadership and key cross-functional teams, independently resolving routine operational matters and appropriately escalating complex or higher-risk issues. The role will also be driving targeted improvements in close execution, controls, automation, and process consistency

12 Months and Beyond

  • The Senior Manager will have established a strong, scalable Revenue Operations team in India, with clear accountability across Managers and Analysts, consistent execution of close and control responsibilities, and increased team capability to independently own complex revenue processes. The role will continue to drive improvements in efficiency, automation, controls, and operational scalability as the business evolves

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Elastic is looking for a Lead Salesforce Engineer who combines deep architectural intuition, clean coding, and sharp debugging skills with an AI-native workflow using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex across the entire stack. Adaptable and deeply curious, you will dive into platforms like Salesforce and MuleSoft while holding an end-to-end ownership mindset to elevate engineering practices and turn ambiguous business challenges into high-quality, reliable production solutions. In this role, success goes beyond ticket counts; you will streamline critical revenue processes, scale platform architecture, and leverage AI to build smart automations that eliminate manual work, serving as a key technical partner driving meaningful business impact.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Design, build, and ship full-stack features end-to-end — UI, APIs, business logic, data models, and integrations — with a strong bias for clean, maintainable, well-tested code.
  • Build modern frontend experiences (component-based UI, responsive design) and robust backend services and APIs, applying solid object-oriented and software design principles.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools — Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar — throughout the SDLC: scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and code review, while maintaining engineering rigor over AI-generated output.
  • Design and implement integrations using REST APIs, event-driven patterns, and enterprise integration practices.
  • Where the work runs on Salesforce, develop using Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, and the platform's security model — with support to ramp up if you're new to the platform.
  • Explore and build agentic and AI-powered features (e.g., Agent Builder, workflow automation, AI agents) that bring real automation and intelligence into business processes, with appropriate governance and human-in-the-loop checks.
  • Own features through the full lifecycle: solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Contribute to CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, and Agile ceremonies; and raise the bar on engineering practices across the team.

What You Bring

  • 12+ years of professional full-stack software engineering experience — strong fundamentals across frontend, backend, APIs, and data.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
  • Proficiency in modern frontend technologies (JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, modern frameworks) and backend development (object-oriented programming, RESTful API design, databases/SQL, data modeling).
  • Hands-on, daily experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar — able to write precise prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and performance.
  • Solid grounding in software design patterns, SDLC, Agile methodologies, Git, and CI/CD practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently design and deliver scalable technical solutions.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Bonus Points

  • A true engineer at heart: someone who can reason about architecture, write clean code, and diagnose hard bugs — with or without AI in the loop.
  • Genuinely AI-native: you reach for Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex by default, and use them to build fluency across the stack, not just in your specialty.
  • Curious and adaptable — comfortable picking up new platforms (including Salesforce, Mulesoft) quickly when the work calls for it.
  • Ownership mindset: you drive features to done, care about quality, and elevate the engineers around you.
  • Excited about applying AI meaningfully to real business problems — automation, decision support, and smarter workflows
  • Take ambiguous business problems and turn them into production solutions.
  • Reduce friction in critical revenue processes.
  • Improve the reliability and scalability of our platform.
  • Deliver solutions faster without sacrificing engineering quality.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work through automation and AI.
  • Become a trusted technical partner for business stakeholders.
  • Leave our architecture and engineering practices better than you found them.

 

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.
